column1: # Example: default: sweep — export a whole scope automatically.
# A block may declare a "default:" rule. When present
# entire scope and exports EVERY asset at that default
# row names — those rows override the default and the sweep skips them ("claim").
#   default: <mode> [WxH] <depth>
#     mode : trimmed (own size
#     depth: direct    (only the scope's direct children)
#            recursive (every leaf layer in the tree
# OUTPUT FOLDERS (important):
#   * Listed rows obey  folder:  ->  OUT/<folderName>/
#   * The swept "rest"  goes to the ROOT export folder  ->  OUT/
#     (recursive sweep mirrors each leaf's group path under OUT/
#      OUT/Jackpots/major/<leaf>.png)
# CLAIM: a row claims the asset it targets AND that asset's whole subtree
# the sweep never re-exports it. In a DIRECT sweep
# any claimed asset is left untouched (it is not flattened) — the rows handle it.
# With NO default: line a block behaves as before (only listed rows export).
# Adjust group/layer names to match your PSD.
# --- Block 1: DIRECT sweep of BSP [ALL]. The five Values are listed (overrides)
# and land in OUT/Values/. Every OTHER direct child of BSP [ALL] is swept at
# canvas 400x400 to OUT/ root. The "Values" group is NOT flattened
# children are claimed by the rows below.
default: canvas 400x400 direct
scope: BSP [ALL]  folder: Values
